title: Oil — Filter Housing — Install the Bayonet Drain Nozzle and the Closed Shroud
abstract: Fits the bayonet drain nozzle and the closed shroud to the oil filter housing so that the housing can be drained to a container instead of down the pylon fairing.

sections.planning_reason: Oil staining on the pylon lower fairing was reported by nine operators, always cleaned as a cosmetic item but also masking the leak checks that follow engine work. Twice it led to an unnecessary component change. The drain nozzle as delivered discharges into a shroud with an open lower edge, so residual oil runs down the shroud during a filter change rather than into the collection point.
sections.description: This bulletin replaces the drain nozzle with a variant carrying a bayonet fitting for the drain hose and replaces the shroud with a closed profile whose lip routes residual oil to the same fitting. The washer at the housing joint is replaced with the current standard. The filter element, the housing and the oil pump are unchanged.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the fan cowl and make the engine safe for oil system work. Drain the housing by the existing method and remove the filter element following AMM-M-79-20-12-600-048-A. Remove the drain nozzle and the open shroud, clean the joint faces and install the current washer. Install the bayonet nozzle and torque as specified, then install the closed shroud, checking that the lip directs to the fitting and does not foul the cowl at the closed position. Refit the filter element, replenish the oil and do a leak check at idle and at take-off power. Wipe and inspect the pylon fairing so that the next check starts from a clean reference, then close the cowl.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft between MSN M00078 and M00377. Aircraft delivered from that MSN carry the post modification standard. Both engines should be embodied at the same visit so that the drain method is the same on each side.
sections.material_note: Kit is per engine and contains the bayonet nozzle, the closed shroud, the washer and one drain hose per aircraft. Removed items are scrapped locally. The drain hose is reusable and is not consumed by the task.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next filter element change, at the operator's convenience.
